subject: Discrepancy: February spike tied to tokenizer/packing change
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightoakhealth.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Sudden Feb usage spike — can you explain?

Jonas,

We noticed a 3x jump in tokens billed on 2027-02-18 that we can't explain. No product changes on our side. Can you send a usage export and a short root-cause? We're looking at a $4.8k unexpected charge on this cycle. Attached is our internal summary (screenshot).

Thanks,
Samir
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightOak Health
[attachment: screenshot-oversample.png]
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightoakhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-20T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden Feb usage spike — can you explain?

Samir — thanks for flagging this. I'm pulling the export now and will include a short analysis. At first glance we see a high concentration of long batched requests on 2027-02-18 that correlate with a tokenizer boundary change in one of our newer runner images (internal tag: runner-2027-02-17).

Next steps:
- I will attach the per-request export (CSV) and a tokenizer diff we generated.
- Laura will coordinate a provisional credit while we confirm root cause.
- Evelyn, can you confirm whether runner-2027-02-17 was part of the canary that day?

Jonas
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: brightoak_usage_export_20270220.csv]
From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-20T10:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden Feb usage spike — can you explain?

On Wed, Feb 20, 2027 at 10:05 AM jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> Jonas — thanks for flagging this. I'm pulling the export now and will include a short analysis.

Confirmed — runner-2027-02-17 was promoted to a small set of hosts for a performance patch (token packing/utf8-normalization). It was expected to be a no-op for existing customers but logs show it changed tokenization for some combined-emoji/unicode sequences, which can double-tokenize in edge cases.

I'll attach the tokenizer diff and a short extract of a couple of request payloads showing doubled token counts. We should offer a provisional billing credit while infra finishes a fix and then provide a mitigation plan (pin model/runtime).

Evelyn
Infra Reliability
[attachment: tokenizer-diff-logs.txt]
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Samir Patel <samir@brightoakhealth.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-20T12:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden Feb usage spike — proactive credit & remediation plan

Samir — we appreciate the quick heads-up and sorry for the disruption. Summary of our findings so far:

- Root cause: A tokenizer-normalization change in runner-2027-02-17 caused certain emoji + ZWJ sequences and combined diacritics to be split into additional tokens for ~6% of BrightOak requests on 2027-02-18.
- Impact: ~3x token spike for affected requests; overall account-level increase driven by long-batched inference jobs.
- Immediate remediation: we rolled back the runner change at 03:40 UTC on 2027-02-19 and will release a patch that preserves previous tokenization behavior for customers who need it.

Proposed remediation and next steps:
1) Provisional credit: we can apply a one-time adjustment equal to the overage portion attributable to the tokenizer regression (preliminary estimate $3,600).
2) Usage export: attached CSV with per-request tokens and indicators.
3) Permanent options: (a) Pin BrightOak to pre-2027-02-17 tokenizer in Dedicated/Private; (b) provide a post-processing token-normalizer you can run client-side to avoid double-counting on legacy text.
4) Joint RCA call: would you be available Thursday 2/22 at 10:00 AM PT?

If that works I'll open a billing case and create a HubSpot note (linked).

Thanks — Laura
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[attachment: brightoak_usage_export_20270220.csv]
From: Samir Patel <samir@brightoakhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, Billing Ops <billing@brightoakhealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sudden Feb usage spike — proactive credit & remediation plan

Laura / team — thanks for the quick investigation and the provisional credit offer. A few clarifying asks before we confirm the call:

- Can you provide the per-day cost delta (preliminary) rather than the single overage number, so our finance folks can see the trend?
- Please include whether any of the affected requests were routed to a cheaper model variant (we saw some fallback traces in our logs).
- We'll take 2/22 10:00 AM PT for the joint RCA call — invite Samir + Finance + Eng (I'll send the calendar).

Appreciate the remediation options. If you can also add a short note about whether this could reoccur after the rollback (risk level), that helps procurement when approving the credit.

Samir
Director, Platform Engineering
BrightOak Health
